arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST((T1."XCL_029" - T1."XCL_028") AS REAL) * 100 / T1."XCL_028"
FROM district AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_019" = 'north Bohemia'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account AS T2
    INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T2."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_015"
    INNER JOIN card AS T5 ON T4."XCL_013" = T5."XCL_006"
    WHERE T2."XCL_002" = T1."XCL_017"
      AND T2."XCL_003" = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND T5."XCL_007" = 'classic'
  )
